title: Create a pipeline that adds the team label to metrics

blocks.content:
In this milestone, you create a configuration pipeline that does the following:

- Collects Linux host metrics

- Labels those metrics with the `team` attribute of each collector using [pipeline attribute injection](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/send-data/fleet-management/set-up/configuration-pipelines/pipeline-attribute-injection/)

- Sends the metrics to Grafana Cloud.
To create and assign the pipeline, complete the following steps:
Go to **Fleet Management**.
Click the **Remote configuration** tab.
blocks.tooltip: The Remote configuration tab lists all configuration pipelines and lets you create, edit, activate, and deactivate them.

blocks.content: Click **Create configuration pipeline**.
Make sure **Alloy** is selected as the collector type, then click **Custom configuration**.
Click **Next** to define the pipeline.
In the **Name** field, enter this name for the pipeline: `team_cost_metrics`.
Click **Test configuration pipeline** and wait for the **Configuration test passed** message.
Click **Next** to assign the pipeline to collectors.
In the **Select Attribute** dropdown, select `team`.
Set the operator to `=~` to match with a regular expression.
In the **Select Value** field, enter `.+`. The collector list updates in real time and shows every collector that has a `team` value.
Click **+** to add a second matching attribute. The pipeline collects Linux host metrics, so it must match only Linux collectors.
In the new row, select the `os` attribute, keep the `=` operator, and enter `linux` as the value.
Click **Save**, then confirm in the dialog to save the pipeline.

In the **Active** column, turn on the toggle for the `team_cost_metrics` pipeline. A new pipeline is inactive until you activate it.

> **Caution:** When you activate the pipeline, every matched collector starts sending metrics to Grafana Cloud at their next poll. This telemetry can affect your bill.
Click **Activate** to confirm.

Your pipeline is active. Each matched collector applies the pipeline on its next poll and starts sending metrics with a `team` label.

In the next milestone, you confirm that the `team` label appears on your metrics.
